requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory stores its USDC (quoteToken), protocolTreasury, and Chainlink VRF configuration as immutable or constant values and creates raffles atomically as ERC-1167 minimal proxy clones.
requirements.quote: /// @notice Defines atomic ERC-1167 raffle creation for one immutable USDC, treasury, and Chainlink configuration.

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory exposes no owner/admin state or modifiers, no pause mechanism, no upgrade mechanism, no asset rescue functions, and no setters for protocol configuration.
requirements.quote: The factory has no owner, pause, upgrade, rescue, or mutable protocol configuration.

requirements.checkable: Cannot be verified from the onchain Solidity contracts alone because no deployment tooling or scripts are present in scope to check offchain address verification.
requirements.quote:
Deployment tooling must
///      verify that the immutable quote-token address is the target chain's official USDC

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory constructor validates quoteToken_ onchain solely by checking quoteToken_.code.length > 0 and IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals() == 6.
requirements.quote:
onchain construction checks
///      only code presence and six-decimal metadata.

requirements.checkable: CreateRaffleParams contains (address sponsorRecipient, address prizeToken, uint256 prizeTokenId, uint128 reserveEntries, uint64 endTime) and createRaffle passes these fields into clone initialization and atomic prize escrow.

createRaffle emits RaffleCreated with the exact configured and factory parameters only after the clone is initialized, registered in factory mappings, funded with the prize NFT, and verified to be in the Active status.
RaffleFactory reverts with ZeroAddress() when a required address parameter checked for zero (protocolTreasury_ in constructor or params.sponsorRecipient in createRaffle) is address(0).
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Raised when a required address is the zero address.
    error ZeroAddress();

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory reverts with NotContract(account) when quoteToken_, vrfWrapper_, or params.prizeToken has account.code.length == 0.
RaffleFactory constructor reverts with UnsupportedQuoteToken(quoteToken_) when calling IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals() reverts or fails to return a uint8.
RaffleFactory constructor reverts with InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals(quoteDecimals, 6) when IERC20Metadata(quoteToken_).decimals() returns a value not equal to 6.
createRaffle reverts with UnsupportedPrizeToken(params.prizeToken) when IERC165(params.prizeToken).supportsInterface(type(IERC721).interfaceId) reverts or returns false.
createRaffle reverts with ZeroReserveEntries() when params.reserveEntries == 0.
requirements.quote:
/// @notice Raised when a raffle is configured with a zero reserve entry threshold.
    error ZeroReserveEntries();

requirements.checkable: createRaffle reverts with InvalidEndTime(block.timestamp, params.endTime) when params.endTime <= block.timestamp.
createRaffle reverts with SaleDurationTooLong(uint256(params.endTime) - block.timestamp, 30 days) when uint256(params.endTime) - block.timestamp > 30 days.

RaffleFactory reverts with UnsafeProtocolDestination(destination) when protocolTreasury_, params.prizeToken, or params.sponsorRecipient matches a known protocol address (the factory, quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, a registered raffle, or prizeToken for sponsorRecipient).

After transferring the prize in createRaffle, RaffleFactory reverts with PrizeEscrowVerificationFailed(raffle, params.prizeToken, params.prizeTokenId) if IERC721(params.prizeToken).ownerOf(params.prizeTokenId) != raffle or IRaffle(raffle).status() != IRaffle.Status.Active.

createRaffle atomically clones raffleImplementation via ERC-1167, initializes the clone, records it in the factory registry, transfers the prize from msg.sender via safeTransferFrom, verifies prize ownership and Active status, and returns the clone address.
quoteToken() returns the immutable 6-decimal quote token address set at factory construction and shared with all created raffles.
vrfWrapper() returns the immutable Chainlink VRF wrapper address set at factory construction and passed to the Raffle implementation.
protocolTreasury() returns the immutable protocol treasury address set at factory construction and passed to every clone in createRaffle.
callbackGasLimit() returns the constant uint32 VRF_CALLBACK_GAS_LIMIT (300,000) used by Raffle when requesting randomness.
requestConfirmations() returns the constant uint16 VRF_REQUEST_CONFIRMATIONS (30) used by Raffle when requesting randomness.
raffleImplementation() returns the immutable locked Raffle implementation contract deployed in the factory constructor and targeted by Clones.clone in createRaffle.
raffleCount() returns the monotonically increasing counter incremented by 1 on each successful createRaffle call, equal to both the total registered raffles and the latest one-based raffleId.
isRaffle(raffle) returns true if and only if raffle was created and registered by this factory via createRaffle.
raffleById(raffleId) returns the registered clone address for a valid 1-based raffleId in [1, raffleCount] and address(0) for 0 or any unknown raffleId.
idByRaffle(raffle) returns the 1-based raffleId assigned during createRaffle for a registered clone and 0 for any unregistered address.
